# Billy Andrews

## Overview

- **Age:** Late teens to young adult
- **Gender:** Male
- **Status:** Alive
- **Origin:** Avonlea, Prince Edward Island
- **Role:** Farmer

## Appearance

Billy is described as a fat, round-faced, slow-moving young man. He has a bland, harmless countenance and broad shoulders. His physical presence is solid and heavy, reflecting his easygoing and unimaginative nature.

## Personality

Billy is extremely shy, quiet, and lacking in conversation. He is good-natured and sensible, but has very little imagination or ambition. He prefers to keep to himself and relies heavily on his sister Jane to speak for him in social situations, especially regarding matters of romance.

## Traits

- Shy and bashful
- Good-natured
- Slow-witted and unimaginative

## Abilities

- Farming skills

## Goals

- To find a reliable wife to settle down with on his farm

## History

Billy grows up in Avonlea alongside his sister Jane Andrews and the other local children. When he decides it is time to marry, he takes a liking to Anne Shirley, admiring her practicality and hard work despite her imaginative quirks. Too bashful to propose to her himself, he sends his sister Jane to propose marriage to Anne on his behalf. Anne promptly rejects the proposal, much to Billy's eventual relief, as he goes on to accept the outcome without much heartbreak.

## Background by volume

- Grew up in Avonlea as part of the Andrews family, neighbors to Green Gables.

## Affiliations

- The Andrews Family — Son and brother

## Relationships

### Jane Andrews

- Sibling of — Sister who acts as his spokesperson
